target_customer: Traders wanting 24/7 leveraged access to US equities, indices, commodities and FX via perpetual futures
problem: Traditional markets close nights and weekends and trade through brokers. QFEX offers a brokerless 24/7 exchange with perpetual futures over traditional assets.
business_model: Exchange trading and clearing fees (inferred from exchange model; fee schedule not opened)
product_category: 24/7 exchange, perpetual futures on traditional assets

founders.name: Annanay Kapila
education: University of Cambridge, mathematics (also quantum computing research)
founders.background_notes: Quant trader in London per YC page; FinTech Global calls him a former HFT at Tower.

founders.name: Joshua Wharton
founders.background_notes: Quant and engineer per YC launch post summary; the two met at Cambridge.

competitors.name: Coinbase perpetual-style futures
competitors.what: Perpetual-style futures in the US and later stock perpetuals for non-US users

technical_complexity.rationale: A low-latency matching engine with 24/7 risk, margining and external market makers requires trading-grade engineering and regulatory structure.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity and market makers compound and licensing is hard, but crypto venues and Coinbase pursue the same product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coinbase, Kraken and One Trading launched equity perpetuals between 2025 and 2026; no acquisition of QFEX found.

market_need_then: Retail demand for off-hours trading and perpetual futures was shown by crypto venues and Coinbase's 2025 moves; founders cite experience at Tower and Citadel.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and confident; The first 24/7 exchange only for global equities, indices and commodities

branding.brand_signature: FTX without the fraud framing in a 4pillars analysis
branding.community_and_virality: 4pillars published a research piece on QFEX in April 2026 and funding was widely covered in March 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Funding press and a third-party research piece give visibility, but the name is an unexplained acronym.

outcome_analysis: QFEX raised a $9.5M seed at a reported $95M valuation led by General Catalyst in March 2026, helped by founders with Tower, Citadel and Cambridge pedigrees. No shutdown or acquisition was found. Crowding by Coinbase, Kraken and One Trading and licensing risk are the main threats.
notes: Cross-check: raising.fi reports 7M GBP led by Yuri Sagalov (General Catalyst partner) per search snippet; VCBacked lists a $500K pre-seed in May 2025, unverified so not recorded. Round date is March 2026 per article dated March 5. QFEX trading is offshore; US equity perpetuals sit in regulatory uncertainty per search results. Business model is inferred.
